description: Interface definition for the ASH Pattern Engine
purpose: Detects cosmic patterns from ASH state analysis and provides generation seeds to all other engines

inputs.name: cosmic_state
inputs.description: Current state of the cosmos from the Cosmology Engine

inputs.name: player_state
inputs.description: Current player state for pattern personalization

inputs.name: ash_state
inputs.description: Nine-coordinate F2^9 ASH state vector consumed as a complete state.

inputs.name: canonical_codeword
inputs.description: One of the fixed 16 full-state ASH codewords.

outputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
outputs.description: Normalized ASH snapshot carrying source orbit, codeword sequence, and diagnostic reference.

outputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
outputs.description: Structured ASH diagnostic record for valid, recoverable, fallback, or no-op conditions.

outputs.name: generation_plan
outputs.description: Side-effect-free generation plan emitted across the materialization boundary.

methods.name: detect_patterns
methods.description: Analyze current ASH state and detect active cosmic patterns

methods.name: get_pattern_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve a specific pattern by its ID

methods.name: evaluate_pattern_strength
methods.description: Calculate the strength of a pattern given current cosmic conditions

methods.name: normalize_ash_state
methods.description: Validate and normalize a complete F2^9 ASH state.

methods.name: transform_by_codeword
methods.description: Apply x' = x XOR c with a canonical full-state codeword.

methods.name: build_cosmic_pattern_snapshot
methods.description: Produce the CosmicPatternSnapshot required by downstream YWE engines.

methods.name: emit_diagnostic_envelope
methods.description: Emit DiagnosticEnvelope records for state validity and recovery decisions.

methods.name: plan_generation
methods.description: Emit a GenerationPlan without materializing artifacts or authoring downstream truth.

invariants: All patterns must derive from ASH cosmological state analysis
No independent random generation of meaningful content
Pattern strength is always between 0 and 1
All expansion engines must read from detected patterns
ASH math uses F2^9 full-state vectors only.
Only the fixed 16 canonical codewords may transform ASH state.
State transition semantics are x' = x XOR c.
CosmicPatternSnapshot, DiagnosticEnvelope, and GenerationPlan are required before downstream materialization.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
